description: Status of a checkout from create_checkout: pending (not paid yet; payment_started says whether the owner reached Stripe), paid (the license is on the account: call get_download), confirm (a free code made it $0: the owner must still open checkout_url and tick the license box), expired or failed; held or needs_refund when a payment arrived that could not be applied as quoted (the answer says what happened and that the owner is refunded or the payment is being checked: never pay again). cannot_pay (with a pending status) means the account changed since the checkout was made and the pay button would refuse it: don't send the owner to it. next_call, when present, is the exact next tool call (get_download once paid; create_checkout or renew_updates with the same order after expired, failed or cannot_pay). poll_after_seconds says how long to wait before checking again. pairs_well_with (when present) lists apps that work with these, best match first, with why, the real price (a companion price where it applies) and the license that price buys (license: site, for site_domain; or unlimited, for all the owner's sites): mention them briefly if useful; never add one or start a checkout for it unless the owner asks. Only your own checkouts are visible. Needs the checkout:create permission, like create_checkout.
name: get_checkout
title: Is the checkout paid?
